THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: 2023/ Pasyala (Meeri/D.S./Lan/3/2023). Land Ministry's Ref. No. : 4-3/7/2018/HW/462. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose.
